entityDescription: Geoapp offers innovative products, services and consultancy aimed at rapidly assessing geological and geotechnical risk in the infrastructure and mining industries. entityDescription: FIDAMC is a Research Center created in 2006 by the Spanish Ministry of Industry, the Regional Government of Madrid and the Airbus Group, focused on the research, development and potential uses of composite materials. The entity is mainly addressed to aerospace activities but widely open to other sectors, having carried out projects in the railway, wind energy and automotive areas. FIDAMC staff number is 80 people, mainly high-skilled engineers, with a strong background on composite materials. FIDAMC facilities are placed in Getafe since 2009, with an area of about 1500 m2 for offices and about 4000 m2 for the physicochemical and mechanical laboratory and the manufacturing workshop. This huge area gives house to the specific state-of-the-art equipment required to carry out all the activities related to the ongoing projects, which will be described below. The main general activities carried out at FIDAMC are: • The improvement of technologies already known and the analysis, test and demonstration of emerging technologies; • The selection of the optimal ways to use those technologies in specific products; • The cooperation to establish specific Design Principles/Stress methods; • The suggestion of new research lines to Universities, R&D Labs or other Technological Centers which can cooperate potentially with FIDAMC. All the tasks done can be included in a range from TR4 to TR6 in the standard scale of NASA, which takes into account the aspects related to the technology maturity level.

entityName: UNIV FIRENZE - Dipartimento di Scienze della Terra (DST)
entityDescription:
Research organization
The Earth Science Department – DST – of the University of Florence resulted as one of the 180 Italian Departments of Excellence selected by MIUR (Ministry of University and Research) for the high quality in research. The prestigious award is a prize for the efforts done in the past recent years by the researchers of DST toward the development of highly innovative research and didactic projects and for the excellence level of the different products of the research.
For this reason, the MIUR assigned, for the period 2018-2022, an extraordinary fund dedicated to the development of strategic actions aimed at producing a sound influence in the socio-economictissueof the community. The investments will be dedicated to enforce and create new scientific knowledges in different fields:
- Sustainable development of the Earth system, assessment and mitigation of different geo-risks (volcanic, seismic, hydrogeologic);
- Land planning and defense of high vulnerability areas, with special attention to all those processes inducing rapid geo-environmental changes;
- Enhancement of security and life quality of the community.
- Conservation of the cultural heritage.

entityDescription:
ElFys, Inc. was founded in the fall 2017 to commercialize the innovation of photodetector technologies invented by a group of university researchers. The team has then been complemented with seasoned professionals in industrial manufacturing, sales and marketing. The technologies are protected by several patents. ElFys is the first in the world to combine the latest developments in solar cell technology with light detection, and thus, successfully apply black silicon to light sensing. The technology allows to significantly improve the performance of any device that uses light detectors as ElFys is the first in the world to capture every single ray of light. See for example Juntunen, et.al., Near-unity quantum efficiency of broadband black silicon photodiodes with an induced junction, Nature Photonics 10, 777-781, (2016)

The company utilizes the state-of-the-art processing facilities at Micronova Nanofabrication Center in Espoo, Finland: 2600 square metersof CMOS compatible facilities suitable for both R&D and semi-mass production. For volume production ElFys is in partnership with commercial foundries, having first full processes succesfully completed end 2023.

Our responsibility lies in the interaction of:
- Agriculture
- Rural Economy
- Forestry
- Environmental Sciences
- Veterinary Medicine and Animal Husbandry
- Engineering and Technology
The Estonian University of Life Sciences is large enough to offer a wide range of expertise in its field and provide the opportunity to address topics in collaboration with various specialists in a thorough manner, yet small enough to foster a sense of community and direct interaction between colleagues, faculty, and students.

Helmes is a "digital innovation partner" - because in addition to software development, digital innovation also includes in-depth understanding of the business problem, thinking along with the customer and finding the best solution together. This is where the real value is created - and we certainly do that. Our clients also understand that what they need is not software, but digital innovation. We say about ourselves "partner" and not "company": partner focuses on joint effort, long term win-win cooperation. Helmes provides a world class product developement teams as a service.

We have launched multiple successful projects in the private and public sector. entityDescription: Spacemanic is small satellite mission integrator, focused on delivering innovative and reliable nanosatellite solutions, platforms and components. The company is very strong in the field of design, development and testing of fundamental small satellite components, such as onboard computers, power system units and solar panels. Our engineers are very experienced in the field of radio communication, and ground station design and operations. The Spacemanic transciever for UHF and S bands is very reliable and has been working in space for half year and counting, on board the first Slovak satellite skCUBE. Our products have very good and well documented flight heritage from the CubeSat’s space mission. This includes our highly precise and bespoke sun sensors, magnetometers and magnetorquers. The company Spacemanic is based in Bratislava, Slovakia, with two labs equipped for space mission technology design and development, as well as a small testing facility for nanosatellite missions. We are able to perform the basis required environmental tests needed for nanosatellites. Spacemanic is a spin-off company from the Slovak Organisation for Space Activities (SOSA), which has successfully designed, developed, launched and is operating skCUBE.

entityDescription:
EuroUSC Italia is a consultancy company providing services to Manufacturers, Operators, Insurance companies and Authorities operating in the aviation domain. We are leading experts in regulation and safety in the drone field but we cover also other aviation domains such as ATM/ANS and aerodromes. Established in Rome as a joint venture between Deep Blue Srl and Prof. Filippo Tomasello, our strength is to be completely independent from organisations involved in design, production, marketing or maintenance of drones, parts, components or systems, as well as from operators and flying schools, in line with the requirements laid down for “Qualified Entities” in the EASA Basic Regulation.
With a very dynamic and professional team, we can satisfy customers expectations conjugating high quality with competitive fares. Thanks to our involvement in the major regulatory
and standardization bodies at international level (ICAO, JARUS, EUROCAE and ISO) we help our customers with knowledge, methods and techniques that are always at the state-of-the-art and beyond. EuroUSC Italia is also member of the Board of Directors of UVS-International, the leading world association of drone operators and manufacturers. EuroUSC Italia participates to the European Horizon 2020 programme and is involved in several research projects funded by the European Commission, GSA, EDA and SESAR SJU. In these projects we offer our qualified contribution on: analysis of compliance to applicable regulations, safety assessment using state-ofthe-art methodologies, definition of operational procedures, testing and validation. Activities take place in the context of innovative applications for drones, cutting-edge technologies and infrastructures such as the U-Space.
We are also leading experts in the application of the Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) methodology to fly drones in the new EASA “Specific” Category. We have developed an online tool for the Risk Assessment with SORA: www.online-sora.com

entityDescription:
The purpose of the company is the production and distribution of fiber composites of all kinds. Advice, Construction, Prototypes and Batches – INNOcomposites offers everything from one source.

3 key principles we live
•	Rapid processing to keep TIME as your competitive edge!
•	Full commitment to producing highly resilient components with minimum weight. 
•	100% confidentiality and discretion to preserve your recipe for success a secret. 

Our size allows us to respond immediately to your individual needs and requests. To convert your ideas, we work with the autoclave and infusion method. These technologies ensure an economical, high performing manufacturing process to combine the highest quality with economic benefits.

We offer an in-house developed manufacturing method to build complex hollow bodies that show an outstanding smooth inner surface. This process is much more efficient and ecological than the common sand core method. Not to mention that aerodynamics reaches new dimensions. 

We don’t waste, we recycle! Repair work with prepregs and hand-laminate using vacuum-bagging is the key. By applying these methods, existing fibre composite parts can be repaired or adapted to any request.

INNOcomposites, the CTO respectively, can record 12 years of experience working with the composite material, vacuum presses and infusion technology. The speciality is the processing of composite prepregs using autoclave technology.

Materials we work with
•	Carbon fibre, Fibreglass, Hybrid fibre, PP-fibers (e.g. Zylon fibre, Aramid fibre) (Bild von diversen Materialien)
•	Combining mentioned fibres with metals, polyurethane foams or elastomers (e.g. Airpad, Kraibon)
•	Processing of sandwich constructions such as honeycomb and foam materials (e.g. Nomex, Rohacell)

Supplemental work
•	Segmented moulds
•	Applying adhesives to merge composites (preparation, depth of roughness, etc.)
•	Assembly work (drilling, cutting, rivet, sanding etc.)
•	Applying Punctum® method to create hollow bodies, reaching max. cure level up to 40
